; The proof layout of M5 step 1: the hand-made Stage 1 room t4_broken_rule_yard, drawn the way tools/build_room.gd reads
; a room. tests/tools/test_build_room.gd builds it into a scratch folder (never over the real scene) and requires
; the booted grid, the doors, the entries, the enemies and the pickup of the result to equal the hand-made room's.
; It lives under tests/fixtures/ and not in tools/layouts/, which holds the sources of rooms that ship.
